entry.clock: Date.now, new Date() and the run-limit timeouts are virtual; every other timer of the code under test is real and is printed, by delay, at the end of a recording
entry.featureGit: MIXDOG_FEATURE_GIT is unset, as in the product: no production code sets it (read at builtin-features.mjs:70,219)
entry.git: runChild on the calling thread. The daemon runs the same runChild in its process-runner worker pool (desktop-service.ts:1049-1053, process-runner.mjs:19-37, four threads): the same limits and errors; the spawns of one thread queue, which this recording does not reproduce
entry.notRun: the relay above it, which reads no source-control method or argument: the payload cap (remote-relay.ts:75,190), frame admission (remote-relay-clients.ts:215-217), the handshake and decryption (remote-relay-client-lifecycle.ts:86-99), the transport registrations and the state-resync frame of remote-relay-client-calls.ts:181-455
entry.runs: executeRemoteFrame over createRemoteMethods (remote-methods.ts:1256, :828): the frame parse, the method lookup, every argument check and the desktop operation

notes.githubStatusRefresh: githubCliStatus took no arguments over the relay (remote-methods.ts:562); the core ignores `refresh` on a relay connection and honours it for the desktop's own calls.
notes.loginOptions: githubCliLoginOpenBrowser's second argument (optionalGithubLoginOptions) has no core param: the page checks it and leaves it out (scm-operation-route.ts), so no core request carries it.
notes.loneSurrogate: An open difference, not parity. A JSON string holding an escaped lone surrogate ("\ud800") is a string to Node: its string checks take it and the call acts on it (golden.json limits[lone-surrogate-gitLog-query]; Node's spawn writes it on git's command line as U+FFFD, bytes EF BF BD). The core reads every inbound frame into Rust strings (mixdog-app-protocol rpc.rs decode_inbound_text), which cannot hold one: the frame is invalid and the connection is closed with 1007, for every method, before any check runs. The case is not replayed.
notes.posixCwd: The directory rule is the platform's path.isAbsolute (git-contract.mjs:3), and so is the core's (mixdog-scm input.rs is_absolute): on POSIX only a leading "/" is absolute, so a backslash-rooted, a drive (C:\x) or a UNC spelling is refused there where Windows (this recording) takes it. The trim is JavaScript's on both platforms.
notes.reviewWithoutFiles: The core request of the phone's gitReviewDiff and gitReviewDiffs is one method (review/diff/get, scope repo, patch true): one with neither `path` nor `files` cannot say which call it stands for, and is checked as gitReviewDiff. A request that names either is checked as its own call; the page always names one.
